name: Redis
description: Bounded native Redis strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, keys, transactions and manual-acknowledgement streams, with an embedded upstream Redis client.

permissions.description: Direct Redis TCP/TLS via embedded builtin-only client. Explicit profile credentials or named password/CA secrets; arbitrary dynamic names are user configuration. Mutations confirmed; no automatic replay.

definitions.name: Redis Connection Health (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Connection Health. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

/*
 * Vendored from `cluster-key-slot@1.1.2`
 * (https://github.com/invertase/cluster-key-slot), patched to fix a
 * disagreement with real Redis servers over how an empty hash tag ("{}") is
 * handled.
 *
 * Redis treats an empty hash tag as no tag at all: given `{}` it hashes the
 * whole key and stops searching (see `keyHashSlot()` in Redis's
 * `src/cluster.c`). The upstream single-pass scanner instead falls through
 * and keeps scanning for the next `}`, hashing whatever sits between --
 * which can silently misroute commands and sharded pub/sub subscriptions to
 * the wrong node. Vendoring was necessary because the upstream repository
 * has been archived and is no longer maintained.
 *
 * `lib/index.js` in `cluster-key-slot` is byte-identical between 1.1.1 and
 * 1.1.2 (1.1.2 was a license metadata fix only), so this same fix applies
 * to the version node-redis previously depended on.
 *
 * The fix, marked below, latches the whole-key fallback once the empty-tag
 * case is seen: one extra boolean, no extra pass, no change to the hot path

definitions.name: Redis Get String (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get String. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Set String (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Set String. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Append String (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Append String. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis String Length (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
String Length. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Increment Integer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Increment Integer. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Decrement Integer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Decrement Integer. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Get Multiple Strings. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Set Multiple Strings. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get Hash Field (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Hash Field. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get Multiple Hash Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Multiple Hash Fields. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Set Hash Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Set Hash Fields. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Delete Hash Fields (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Delete Hash Fields. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Hash Field Exists (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Hash Field Exists. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Hash Length (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Hash Length. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Increment Hash Integer (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Increment Hash Integer. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Scan Hash Page (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Scan Hash Page. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Push List Left (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Push List Left. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Push List Right (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Push List Right. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Pop List Left (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pop List Left. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Pop List Right (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Pop List Right. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get List Range (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get List Range. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis List Length (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
List Length. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get List Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get List Index. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Set List Index (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Set List Index. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Trim List (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Trim List. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Remove List Values (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Remove List Values. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Add Set Members (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Add Set Members. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Remove Set Members (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Remove Set Members. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Set Contains Members (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Set Contains Members. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Set Cardinality (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Set Cardinality. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Scan Set Page (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Scan Set Page. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Move Set Member (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Move Set Member. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Add Sorted Set Members (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Add Sorted Set Members. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.documentation:
Remove Sorted Set Members. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get Sorted Set Score (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Sorted Set Score. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get Sorted Set Rank (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Sorted Set Rank. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Increment Sorted Set Score (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Increment Sorted Set Score. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Get Sorted Set Range (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Get Sorted Set Range. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Sorted Set Cardinality (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Sorted Set Cardinality. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Count Sorted Set Scores (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Count Sorted Set Scores. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.

definitions.name: Redis Scan Sorted Set Page (Direct)
definitions.documentation:
Scan Sorted Set Page. Uses vetted Redis commands through embedded @redis/client@6.3.0, direct TCP or verified TLS. Configure host/port/database and passwordSecret (default REDIS_PASSWORD), optional username and caSecret, or builtin $connection RuntimeConnection config/credentials. TLS defaults require; disable is explicit. One operation deadline starts before asynchronous profiles/secrets/module loading; no reconnect/offline replay and $retries must be 0. Mutations require request.confirm=true. Results preserve exact integer text, ordered values, explicit null and binary hex; no provider bodies or credentials in errors. A failure may have committed effects: inspect Redis before a deliberate retry. SCAN COUNT is a hint; oversized pages reject. Transactions queue <=50 vetted scalar-returning commands and cannot roll back EXEC errors; an EXEC error can follow committed commands. Streams are bounded nonblocking one-shot operations with explicit XACK and no automatic acknowledgement; pending entries remain caller-managed. No Pub/Sub/listener/blocking commands, scripting, flush/config/admin, cluster/sentinel or distributed lock guarantee. Sources: https://redis.io/docs/latest/commands/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/connect/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/clients/nodejs/produsage/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/using-commands/transactions/ https://redis.io/docs/latest/develop/data-types/streams/ https://github.com/redis/node-redis/tree/redis%406.3.0

Semantic authoring: new logical ID with direct typed wrapper fields. Prior operation remains compatible. Absence/null/falsy, confirmations and provider behavior are preserved; typed result outputs remain alongside direct fields. No extra provider call.
